title: Linear convergence of iterative contour integral-based eigensolvers for nonlinear eigenvalue problems
summary: Solving nonlinear eigenvalue problems is an important and challenging task in scientific computing. Contour integral-based approaches are attractive for such eigenvalue problems because they reliably target all eigenvalues in a prescribed domain. However, unlike in the linear case, many traditional methods of this type, such as Beyn's method, lack an inherent iterative refinement mechanism.
